Method.name: Transform
GetDataPath
Method.Implementation:
Set tQuery = "select distinct SourceConfigName, TargetConfigName from " _" Ens.MessageHeader mh " _" where sessionId in ( " _" SELECT SessionId " _" FROM Ens.MessageHeader " _" where MessageBodyId = '" _ msgId _ "')" Set tStatement = ##class(%SQL.Statement).%New() Set tStatus = tStatement.%Prepare(tQuery) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tResultSet = tStatement.%Execute() set outStr = "" If (tResultSet.%SQLCODE = 0) { While (tResultSet.%Next()) { Set src = tResultSet.%GetData(1) Set dest = tResultSet.%GetData(2) $$$LOGINFO( "GetDataPath Data from SQL: Src: " _ src _ ", Dest: " _ dest) set outStr = outStr _ src _ "->" _ dest _ ";" } } return outStr

Method.name: GetSrcInputData
Method.Implementation:
Set tQuery = "select distinct MessageBodyId, SourceConfigName, hl7.RawContent " _" from Ens.MessageHeader mh, EnsLib_HL7.Message hl7 " _" where sessionId in ( " _" SELECT SessionId " _" FROM Ens.MessageHeader " _" where MessageBodyId = '" _ msgId _ "')" _" and hl7.ID = mh.MessageBodyId"
Set tStatement = ##class(%SQL.Statement).%New() Set tStatus = tStatement.%Prepare(tQuery) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tResultSet = tStatement.%Execute() set outStr = "Data from Source: " $$$LOGINFO( "GetSrcInputData: " _ tQuery _", " _ tResultSet.%SQLCODE) If (tResultSet.%SQLCODE = 0) { While (tResultSet.%Next()) { Set mId = tResultSet.%GetData(1) Set src = tResultSet.%GetData(2) Set data = tResultSet.%GetData(3) $$$LOGINFO( "GetSrcInputData Data from Source: " _ src _ ", Data: " _ $EXTRACT(data, 1, 100) _ ", Message Id: " _ mId) set outStr = outStr _ src _ ", Data: " _ data _ ", Id: " _ mId } } return outStr
